WITH country_college_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.birth_country,
    COUNT(*) as tally
  FROM player_college pc
  INNER JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(tally) as grand_total,
    AVG(tally) as avg_tally
  FROM country_college_counts
),
countries_with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    ccc.birth_country,
    ccc.tally,
    ccc.tally * 1.0 / s.grand_total as share,
    s.avg_tally
  FROM country_college_counts ccc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM countries_with_metrics
  WHERE tally > avg_tally
)
SELECT 
  SUM(tally) as combined_tally,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(tally - avg_tally) as avg_distance_above
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: "College attendance data" refers to the count of player-college associations in the player_college table, where each row represents one college attendance instance (a player attending a college in a given year).
Players with NULL birth_country are excluded from the tally and grouping.
